rationale: This empirical probit study investigates socioeconomic determinants of computer usage and the digital divide in rural Malaysian communities. It does not address household or community water or sanitation services, water/sanitation governance mechanisms, or water/sanitation access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings because the study is entirely off-topic, examining computer usage and the digital divide rather than water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Determinants of the Digital Divide in Rural Communities of a Developing Country: The Case of Malaysia*
Key socioeconomic factors which impact computer usage in rural agricultural and fishing communities in Malaysia are examined in this study.
